name: Paladine
motif: sweeping dragon wings
ceremony: raises an open hand beneath the dragon's outspread wings

name: Mishakal
motif: interwoven healing hands
ceremony: traces the sign of infinity over your open palms

name: Kiri-Jolith
motif: paired horns and straight borders
ceremony: holds a horn emblem upright while reciting an oath of honorable service

name: Habbakuk
motif: phoenix feathers above curling waves
ceremony: passes a feather above a bowl of clear water

name: Majere
motif: measured webs and mantis limbs
ceremony: observes a measured silence before touching the copper spider emblem

name: Branchala
motif: harp strings threaded through leaves
ceremony: sings a short rising phrase and lets its final note settle

name: Solinari
motif: silver crescents on a white field
ceremony: draws a silver crescent in the air with a white-robed hand

name: Gilean
motif: ordered lines of an unfinished manuscript
ceremony: opens a gray-bound book and speaks a line of remembrance

name: Reorx
motif: hammer heads above interlocking anvil lines
ceremony: strikes a small anvil once and waits for its ringing to fade

name: Zivilyn
motif: roots balanced beneath branching boughs
ceremony: sets a carved branch between you and a bowl of still water

name: Chislev
motif: uncut leaves surrounding a single feather
ceremony: brushes a feather across a living sprig without breaking its stem

name: Sirrion
motif: tongues of flame in flowing arcs
ceremony: turns a lamp so that its changing light falls across your hands

name: Shinare
motif: balanced feathers beside linked trade rings
ceremony: balances two plain rings on a small set of scales

name: Lunitari
motif: scarlet crescents framed by dark geometric lines
ceremony: turns a red disk between lamplight and shadow

name: Takhisis
motif: five dragon heads arranged around a dark center
ceremony: names the five heads in a low, formal invocation

name: Morgion
symbol: a hood with two red eyes
motif: frayed borders beneath a closed hood
ceremony: lowers a hood and speaks a quiet litany through its folds

name: Chemosh
motif: skulls encircled by narrow funerary bands
ceremony: sets a skull emblem beside an unlit funerary candle

name: Sargonnas
motif: hooked feathers descending in angular rows
ceremony: folds a dark feather against a red condor emblem

name: Zeboim
motif: turtle shells beneath breaking storm waves
ceremony: swirls salt water around a turtle emblem before letting it settle

name: Hiddukel
motif: unequal pans hanging from a broken balance
ceremony: tips one pan of a broken scale and closes a hand around its chain

name: Nuitari
motif: dark disks surrounded by barely visible crescents
ceremony: cups a dark disk in both hands and finishes the invocation in a whisper
